fields.name: displayName
fields.tooltip: Name used in spawned object names and HUD text.

fields.name: widthFraction
fields.tooltip: Ramp width as a fraction of the track width, so it keeps reading the same when the width knob moves.

fields.name: length
fields.tooltip: Run-up length in metres — the slope the ship rides before the lip.

fields.name: rampAngle
fields.tooltip: Slope of the ramp. The lip height is length × tan(angle), and the ship leaves the lip at this angle.

fields.name: entryMargin
fields.tooltip: How far inside the ramp's edge the ship's centre must be to enter it (half the ship's width). Closer to the edge is a side hit.

fields.name: airDistancePerSpeed
fields.tooltip: Metres of flight per m/s of takeoff speed. 0.6 throws a 250 m/s launch 150 m and a 1000 m/s ship 600 m (before the cap).

fields.name: airDistanceRange
fields.tooltip: Shortest and longest arc, in metres of track. The upper end is the exclusion the generator keeps clear ahead of every ramp.

fields.name: landingClearance
fields.tooltip: Straight, level, flat road kept BEYOND the longest possible landing, metres. A ramp is only placed where the road can stay straight from its lip to here — the longest jump is the arc cap × the ship's jump strength (the Store raises it) — so a jump always lands on the road it left, never on a wall or round a corner.

fields.name: airControlFactor
fields.tooltip: Steering and dash authority while airborne, as a fraction of grounded.

fields.name: sideHitSpeedLoss
fields.tooltip: Fraction of the current speed lost when the ship hits the ramp from the side (a fraction, because speed grows all run).
